## What do you want to do? {.section-heading}

Choose a goal to see the most relevant guides and tutorials.

::: {.goal-grid}
<div class="goal-card">
  <span class="goal-number">01</span>
  <h3><a class="learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Genotype Data" href="?filter=Genotype%20Data#all-learning-materials">Prepare genotype data</a></h3>
  <p>Import, transform, standardize, and export genotype or variant data for downstream analysis.</p>
  <a class="goal-link learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Genotype Data" href="?filter=Genotype%20Data#all-learning-materials">View tutorials</a>
</div>

<div class="goal-card">
  <span class="goal-number">02</span>
  <h3><a class="learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Data Quality" href="?filter=Data%20Quality#all-learning-materials">Improve data quality</a></h3>
  <p>Filter markers and samples, diagnose missingness, and validate analysis-ready datasets.</p>
  <a class="goal-link learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Data Quality" href="?filter=Data%20Quality#all-learning-materials">View tutorials</a>
</div>

<div class="goal-card">
  <span class="goal-number">03</span>
  <h3><a class="learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Ploidy & Dosage" href="?filter=Ploidy%20%26%20Dosage#all-learning-materials">Analyze polyploids</a></h3>
  <p>Work with allele dosage, ploidy, aneuploidy, and large-scale copy-number variation.</p>
  <a class="goal-link learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Ploidy & Dosage" href="?filter=Ploidy%20%26%20Dosage#all-learning-materials">View tutorials</a>
</div>

<div class="goal-card">
  <span class="goal-number">04</span>
  <h3><a class="learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Population Analysis" href="?filter=Population%20Analysis#all-learning-materials">Understand populations</a></h3>
  <p>Explore structure, diversity, relatedness, and other population-level patterns.</p>
  <a class="goal-link learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Population Analysis" href="?filter=Population%20Analysis#all-learning-materials">View tutorials</a>
</div>

<div class="goal-card">
  <span class="goal-number">05</span>
  <h3><a class="learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Trait Mapping" href="?filter=Trait%20Mapping#all-learning-materials">Map traits</a></h3>
  <p>Move from curated genotype and phenotype data toward GWAS, QTL, and association analyses.</p>
  <a class="goal-link learn-filter-link" data-learn-filter="Trait Mapping" href="?filter=Trait%20Mapping#all-learning-materials">View tutorials</a>
